what_v5_measured_and_what_v6_added: v5 asked whether a wrong path was still functionally violable at all and found 34 of 62. v6 asked a harder question of those 34: can the wrong path be taken while doing a fresh, neutral maintenance task that was authored without knowledge of the decision. Under that condition 17 survive. The difference is not that v5 was wrong; it is that a violation reachable in isolation is not always reachable while doing something else.
why_this_is_a_result_and_not_a_failure: The study set out to measure whether automatic decision delivery helps an agent avoid a recorded wrong path. For half of this corpus the wrong path is already closed by the repository's own tests -- an agent doing the task cannot take it and pass. That bounds where decision delivery can help, and it was measured rather than assumed.
